decision_reason: User rejected the F2/out-of-frame branch-valve concept, identified the standard-layout and strain-basis failures, and requested KEL implementation in the toolchain.
required_evidence: Regression test that a branch valve outside GD-ST span fails BRANCH_VALVE_OUTSIDE_GD_ST_SPAN.
Regression test that F2/F2D without connection-system evidence fails UNJUSTIFIED_F2_FOR_BRANCH_VALVE.
Regression test that a PS ILT-Z anchor with tee, valve, and end inside GD-ST passes the new gate.
